verses.text: I [am] rejoicing over Your word like one finding great plunder.

verses.text: Deception I hate and abhor; Your law I do love.

verses.text: Seven times in the day I praise You, because of the judgments of Your righteousness.

verses.text: Great prosperity [is] unto those loving Your law, and nothing to them [is] a stumbling block.

verses.text: I wait for Your salvation, O YHWH, and Your commandments I have done.

verses.text: My soul has kept Your testimonies, and I love them exceedingly.

verses.text: Let my cry come near before Your face, O YHWH; according to Your word, give me understanding.

verses.text: Let Your hand be to help me, for Your precepts I have chosen.

verses.text: I long for Your salvation, O YHWH, and Your law [is] my delight.

segments.text: I long for Your salvation, O YHWH, and Your law [is] my delight.

verses.text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise You; and may Your judgments help me.

verses.text: I have gone astray, getting lost like a sheep; may You seek Your servant, for Your commandments I have not forgotten.
